subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should every Control UI bootstrap configuration request abandon the server-provided configuration after 15 seconds, including on existing slow reverse-proxy deployments?
rationale: The timeout fixes an indefinite wait, but the exact deadline is startup policy that can change an existing installation from eventually loading its configuration to silently using fallback values.

options.title: Accept 15 seconds with UI proof
options.body: Keep the proposed deadline after real browser or embedded-WebView proof shows the application proceeds correctly when the endpoint stalls.

options.title: Choose an owner-approved deadline
options.body: Replace 15 seconds with an existing shared timeout policy or a longer value that preserves supported slow deployments while still bounding startup.

options.title: Pause the fixed-cutoff change
options.body: Keep this PR open until the supported slow-response contract and fallback consequences are understood.

recommendation.title: Accept 15 seconds with UI proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed deadline after real browser or embedded-WebView proof shows the application proceeds correctly when the endpoint stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this contributor to the Control UI application/bootstrap ownership boundary.
